entities.name: Shell of the Last Kappa
entities.description: A legendary artifact on Kamigawa during the Kami War, a magical relic displayed in a shrine that looked like a large reflective turtle shell.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where the Shell was kept.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War on Kamigawa during which the Shell existed.

entities.name: Kappa
entities.description: Creatures thought extinct before the Kami War but seen again during the Neon Dynasty.

entities.name: Neon Dynasty
entities.description: Era centuries later in which kappa were seen.

events.summary: Kappa, thought extinct before the Kami War, were seen centuries later during the Neon Dynasty.
events.quote: this was proved to be false, as centuries later, the kappa were seen during the Neon Dynasty
